title: Art
heroImageAlt: Bright garden room opening onto a sea-view patio, with two of Jeanette's artworks on the walls and patterned beanbag, cubes and cushions
intro1: Jeanette's art explores order and chaos, repetition and disruption. She investigates colour, perception and the relationship between a work and its viewer, and how each person's way of seeing becomes part of the piece.
intro2: Working mainly in print and paint, her process is rooted in investigation and precision, with measurement and experimentation central to the development of each piece.
